proxy.title: Local Proxy
proxy.description: Claude Desktop can reach non-Anthropic providers through this proxy. It starts automatically when you switch to a provider using the local-proxy protocol.
proxy.statusUnavailable: Proxy status is unavailable. Refresh to try again.
proxy.failoverDescription: When enabled, network or retryable upstream errors try backup providers by group and list order (up to 3 hops). Two consecutive failures open that provider's circuit for 60 seconds. Disabled by default.
proxy.failoverGroupHint: Priority: lower group first, then provider list order. Configure group and model allowlist in the provider editor.
proxy.hotSwitchDescription: In proxy mode, switching the current provider applies on the next request without restarting the proxy port. If the CLI is not pointed at the local proxy (direct mode), in-process env may still need a CLI restart.
proxy.retryCodesHint: Retryable HTTP status codes (ranges like 400-404 are allowed, comma-separated)
proxy.idleTimeoutHint: Streaming idle timeout in seconds. Forwarding stops if no data arrives within this window.
proxy.opencodeDirectHint: OpenCode connects directly to each protocol endpoint via the AI SDK (baseURL + API key) and does not use the local proxy; switch its configuration on the Providers page.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Request, token, and estimated-cost data from local-proxy logs. Codex / Claude Code can also sync local session JSONL. Direct Anthropic-compatible third-party traffic has no live proxy rows—use Sync sessions to backfill.
usage.codexLocalAvailable: Parsed {{events}} token-delta events from {{sessions}} local sessions. This excludes HTTP status, third-party billing, and account quota.
usage.codexLocalUnavailable: No parseable local Codex token events were found in this range. Account quota and credentials are never read.
usage.codexEmptyHint: Click Sync Codex sessions, and confirm the sessions directory on the Environment page points to ~/.codex/sessions. If the period is Today / 24h, try Last 7 days first.
usage.codexEmptyNarrowPeriodHint: No Codex usage in the current period (Today / 24h). Older session events may still exist — switch to Last 7 days, or Sync to import the latest sessions.
usage.codexNoProxyLogs: Codex does not use the local proxy, so there are no proxy request logs. Summary and charts above come from local session events.
usage.codexRequestLogsHint: Rows include local-proxy HTTP requests and token events synced from ~/.codex/sessions. Session rows are hidden when a matching proxy row exists.
usage.claudeCodeLocalAvailable: Parsed {{events}} usage events from {{sessions}} session files (proxy + session sync).
usage.claudeCodeLocalUnavailable: No Claude Code usage in this range. If you call an Anthropic-compatible upstream directly, sync ~/.claude/projects, or switch to a managed provider via the local proxy for live accounting.
usage.claudeCodeEmptyHint: Direct third-party APIs (not the local proxy) are not logged live. Sync project session JSONL, switch to a managed proxy provider, or widen the period. Costs require matching model names in the pricing table.
usage.opencodeRebuildDone: Rebuilt from {{scanned}} OpenCode sessions; wrote {{inserted}} rows
usage.currencyLimit: Estimated cost is tracked per pricing currency. When multiple currencies appear, amounts are converted to USD with approximate FX rates (e.g. CNY ≈ 7.25 per USD) and summed. The detail list still shows native amounts.
usage.cachePricingIncluded: Estimated cost includes separate input, cache-read, cache-write, and output-token rates. Requests without upstream usage are excluded.
usage.calendarLegend: Daily tokens relative to the peak day
usage.name: Name
usage.noData: No proxy request logs in this period

usage.noPricing: No model pricing yet; costs are calculated as $0

usage.maintenancePreview: {{total}} logs currently stored; {{byAge}} will be removed by age and {{byLimit}} by the row limit.

localization.confirmRestore: Restore the localization backup matching this Claude version?

antigravity.title: Antigravity Gateway
antigravity.subtitle: Reverse-proxy Google / Antigravity accounts into local Anthropic / OpenAI-compatible APIs for Claude Code, Codex, and other agents.
antigravity.personalUseNotice: Personal-use gateway only. Review upstream terms yourself; do not operate as a commercial relay.
antigravity.outboundHint: Outbound proxy for Google / Cloud Code. In China use Clash SOCKS5 (default socks5://127.0.0.1:17891), not http://; overseas can choose Direct.
antigravity.modelsEmpty: No model catalog yet. Sign in and click Refresh quota.
antigravity.modelsHint: Refreshing quota syncs live Antigravity models; /v1/models and provider binding use this list. Prefer Gemini level suffixes (e.g. gemini-3.6-flash-low / -high) in each client's model picker. In Claude Desktop, use role routing (name=claude-sonnet-5 + labelOverride=gemini-3.6-flash) for the native effort slider; the gateway keeps the last explicit effort per session and defaults bare Gemini to high when effort is absent. For Codex, re-run Ensure Provider — protocol is openai_responses (/v1/responses).
antigravity.importOptional: Optional: paste account JSON exported from Antigravity-Manager if you already have it.
antigravity.howToAddOauth: Recommended: click “Sign in with Google in browser”, finish Google consent, and the account will show up in the list.
antigravity.howToAddNotIde: Note: signing into the Antigravity website/IDE does not sync into this app. You must click “Sign in with Google in browser” here.
antigravity.howToAddJson: Browsers do not generate refresh_token JSON by themselves. You only get JSON after OAuth login here or an export from Antigravity-Manager.
antigravity.oauthLogin: Sign in with Google in browser
antigravity.emptyAccounts: No accounts yet. Sign in with Google, or import JSON.
antigravity.bindNeedsAccount: Add at least one account before binding the current app.
antigravity.providerReady: Built-in Antigravity provider ready — switch it on the Providers page
